data.description: Stunning Property | Distinctive Design | Exceptional Amenities
data.display_address: Damac City, Al Safa 1, Al Safa, Dubai
data.long_description:
Safa One is an extraordinary development by Damac, designed in collaboration with the renowned jewelry designer Fawaz Gruosi, founder of the De Grisogono brand. This stunning project features two towers, standing at 44 and 62 floors, offering luxurious 1-3 bedroom apartments with exquisite finishes inspired by De Grisogono. The vibrant colors and precious stones used in the interiors set new benchmarks for elegance and make Safa One a standout in Dubai's skyline. Each residence boasts a private balcony, with select apartments featuring terraces complete with private pools.


  A highlight of Safa One is its innovative design. Every balcony is adorned with a mini garden, including a lush tree, bringing a refreshing and natural element to the building's architecture. The sleek glass facades are beautifully complemented by the greenery, creating a harmonious and eco-friendly environment.


  Residents at Safa One enjoy an exceptional range of amenities. The development features two unique golden sand beach pools, a luxurious spa, cafes, restaurants, and scenic bicycle paths along the canal. The crowning glory is the rooftop garden, situated 32 meters high, with manicured landscapes and the tranquil presence of soaring birds. Additionally, the complex is ideally located near Al Safa Park, one of Dubai’s greenest spaces, and Dar Wasl shopping center. La Mer Beach is just a 15-minute drive away, while Dubai Mall and Dubai Marina are 10 and 25 minutes away, respectively.
